phaseBaselines.preservationPolicy: Phase 2B reads and hashes Phase 1/2 artifacts; it never writes their report, documentation, or team-game files.

dataset.marketSource: nflverse / nfldata single settled historical market line; unnamed book, no row timestamp, not independently verified as closing

methodology.selectionPolicy: Exactly 12 user-predefined classic/common angle families and only their requested football-relevant variants; no optimized cutoff, recursive combination, team exclusion, or arbitrary window.
methodology.priorGame: Immediately previous same-season team-game from the locked Phase 1 chronology.
methodology.atsAndSu: Inherited from locked Phase 1 team-relative spread and grading fields.
methodology.uncertainty: 95% Wilson interval over ATS decisions; pushes excluded; descriptive and unclustered.
methodology.roi: Standard -110 ROI over ATS decisions; pushes excluded.
methodology.evidence: Inherited Phase 1 evidence classifier using full history, recent form, fixed eras, Wilson interval, ROI/effect context, and minimum sample/season gates.

nightGames.monday: Eastern weekday is Monday and kickoff is at or after 7:00 p.m. ET
nightGames.sunday: Eastern weekday is Sunday and kickoff is at or after 8:00 p.m. ET

methodology.overtime: nflverse overtime == 1; scores are not used to infer overtime
methodology.secondDivisionalMeeting: Same-season divisional head-to-head regular-season games ordered by kickoff UTC then game ID.

sourceAudit.overtimeDetection: nflverse overtime == 1; scores are not used to infer overtime
sourceAudit.mondayNightDetection: Eastern weekday is Monday and kickoff is at or after 7:00 p.m. ET
sourceAudit.sundayNightDetection: Eastern weekday is Sunday and kickoff is at or after 8:00 p.m. ET

strongestBroadPatterns: Coming off overtime: 198-223-11 ATS (47.0%, -10.2% ROI; n=432) full history and 78-73-3 (51.7%, -1.4% ROI; n=154) recent.
After scoring 40+ points: 197-215-10 ATS (47.8%, -8.7% ROI; n=422) full history and 61-75-1 (44.9%, -14.4% ROI; n=137) recent.
After an outright upset loss: 618-583-38 ATS (51.5%, -1.8% ROI; n=1239) full history and 218-193-15 (53.0%, 1.3% ROI; n=426) recent.
recentStrengtheningOrWeakening: Double-digit favorites: strengthened by 3.4% versus full history.
Double-digit underdogs: weakened by 3.4% versus full history.
Coming off overtime: strengthened by 4.6% versus full history.
After allowing 40+ points: weakened by 3.6% versus full history.
eraReversals: Double-digit favorites: 48.5% older era versus 50.2% newer era.
Double-digit underdogs: 51.4% older era versus 49.8% newer era.
After an outright upset loss: 49.4% older era versus 53.7% newer era.
Coming off overtime: 42.1% older era versus 53.2% newer era.
Coming off Monday Night Football: 47.2% older era versus 51.9% newer era.
Coming off Sunday Night Football: 50.8% older era versus 46.9% newer era.
After allowing 40+ points: 51.8% older era versus 47.7% newer era.
commonNarrativesContradicted: Home underdogs did not establish a broad ATS edge in the fixed full-history and recent windows.
Road favorites did not establish a broad ATS edge in the fixed full-history and recent windows.
After an outright upset win did not establish a broad ATS edge in the fixed full-history and recent windows.
Second divisional meeting did not establish a broad ATS edge in the fixed full-history and recent windows.
notablePredefinedVariantDifferences: Home underdogs: +7 or more was highest at 55.5% ATS (n=296); +3.5 to +6.5 was lowest at 48.4% (n=475).
Road favorites: -3.5 to -6.5 was highest at 51.6% ATS (n=475); -7 or more was lowest at 44.5% (n=296).
Double-digit favorites: Current game: home was highest at 51.1% ATS (n=386); Current game: road was lowest at 40.6% (n=98).
Double-digit underdogs: Current game: home was highest at 59.4% ATS (n=98); Current game: road was lowest at 48.9% (n=386).
After an outright upset win: Prior underdog +3.5 to +6.5 was highest at 50.4% ATS (n=407); Prior underdog +7 or more was lowest at 45.5% (n=205).
After an outright upset loss: Prior favorite -7 or more was highest at 57.1% ATS (n=205); Prior favorite -0.5 to -3 was lowest at 49.8% (n=627).
Coming off overtime: Current game: road was highest at 52.4% ATS (n=227); Current game: home was lowest at 40.8% (n=200).
Coming off Monday Night Football: Current favorite was highest at 50.5% ATS (n=287); Current underdog was lowest at 48.3% (n=245).
Coming off Sunday Night Football: Current underdog was highest at 51.8% ATS (n=146); Current game: road was lowest at 47.3% (n=251).
Second divisional meeting: Current underdog lost first meeting was highest at 52.3% ATS (n=478); Current team won first meeting was lowest at 47.4% (n=714).
After scoring 40+ points: Current game: road was highest at 51.3% ATS (n=235); Current game: home was lowest at 43.6% (n=184).
After allowing 40+ points: Allowed 50+ was highest at 60.4% ATS (n=51); Current game: home was lowest at 45.8% (n=220).

limitations: The nflverse/nfldata spread remains a single unnamed, untimestamped settled historical line and is not independently verified as closing consensus.
Team-game observations from the same game and repeated teams/seasons are dependent; Wilson intervals are unclustered descriptive context.
Night-game definitions use deterministic weekday/time thresholds, not broadcast-network branding metadata.
Evidence classifications are broad reference labels, not multiple-testing-adjusted claims or permission to promote an angle into a model.
